title: Outboard Flap Carriage Support — Pin Bore Borescope Inspection

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Wing Trailing Edge — Flap Support Structure

abstract: Borescope inspection of the outboard flap carriage support pin bore for fretting, done with the flap extended and the carriage pin withdrawn just far enough to expose the bore surface.

sections.purpose: This task gives the borescope inspection of the pin bore of the outboard flap carriage support lug, and the fretting limits that decide whether the fitting can stay in service.
sections.job_setup_note: The flap must be fully extended and supported on the carriage cradle before the pin is disturbed. The borescope must have a working length of at least 600 mm and a measuring reticle. The bore surface must be clean and dry: the inspection cannot be read through residual grease, and the cleaning step must be completed before the borescope enters the bore.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: SUPPORT THE FLAP ON THE CARRIAGE CRADLE BEFORE THE CARRIAGE PIN IS DISTURBED. THE FLAP FALLS IF THE PIN IS WITHDRAWN WITHOUT SUPPORT. 2. Extend the flap fully and make the flap system safe. 3. Remove the trailing edge lower panel to open the access to the carriage. 4. Withdraw the carriage pin to the marked position only, so that the bore is exposed but the carriage stays captive. 5. Clean the bore with the approved solvent and the bore swab, and let it dry. 6. CAUTION: DO NOT WITHDRAW THE PIN BEYOND THE MARKED POSITION. THE CARRIAGE CAN DROP OUT OF THE TRACK. 7. Introduce the borescope and examine the full bore surface of the support lug D5730124726204. 8. Measure any fretting patch against the reticle and record its length, its angular position and its axial position. 9. Examine the adjacent cleat BRDE298405-27 land for movement or for fretting product. 10. Make sure that a fretting patch longer than 8 mm, or any patch that breaks the bore surface, is reported to the engineering organisation before the aircraft is released. 11. Install the carriage pin and lockwire it. 12. Install the trailing edge panel.
sections.close_out: Remove the carriage cradle and retract the flap through one full cycle under the flap drive system test. Make sure that the trailing edge panel fasteners are all installed and torqued. Record the inspection result, including a nil return, in the aircraft technical record.

type_data.effectivity_note: CIRRANE-13 aircraft pre the thickened bearing land standard. The task is withdrawn on aircraft that have been brought to that standard.

safety_precautions: Support the flap on the carriage cradle before the pin is disturbed.
Make the flap drive system safe and put the warning notices in the flight compartment.
Do not stand below the flap while the pin is withdrawn.
